source: Fraley, R.C., Waller, N.G., & Brennan, K.A. (2000). An item response theory analysis of self-report measures of adult attachment. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 78, 350-365. Standard open academic instrument.

dimensions.ANX: Attachment Anxiety - fear of abandonment / need for reassurance
dimensions.AVD: Attachment Avoidance - discomfort with closeness / dependence

scoring_notes: 18 items per dimension. Reverse items: value = (7 - answered). Average per dimension gives a 1-6 score (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice). Attachment style categories are then derived by crossing the two dimensions: low ANX + low AVD = secure; high ANX + low AVD = anxious-preoccupied; low ANX + high AVD = dismissive-avoidant; high ANX + high AVD = fearful-avoidant. Cutoff is 3.5, the original 1-7 midpoint (4) rescaled proportionally to 1-6; see ecrr_mapping.json rules.
